content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade

The training is offered for the position of Passenger Service Agent (Trainee) focusing on passenger handling functions in Terminal, Ramp, and Cargo areas at Veer Savarkar International Airport, Sri Vijaya Puram (Formerly known as Port Blair).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Aviation Institutes and colleges can apply by providing a list of candidates. Specific educational qualifications, age limits, and detailed candidate eligibility criteria are not explicitly printed in the notification, other than submission through recognized Aviation Training Institutes.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo on-the-job training for an initial period of 11 months with a monthly stipend of Rs. 10,000/-. Trainees will work 6 days a week in a 3-shift pattern (including night shifts) with one paid weekly off and holidays, provided they have been present for the previous six days of the week. Trainees are also eligible for 1 leave per month during the tenure of their engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIASL Passenger Service Agent (Trainee)
content_sections.text: Aviation Training Institutes or colleges must prepare a list of candidates containing details such as name, age, qualifications, and contact details on the company's letterhead for screening purposes. Compile details and documents of affiliations or accreditations of the institute along with the company profile. Send the required details and documents to the designated email ID: [email protected] by the last date of 21 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on personal interviews after the screening of candidate lists provided by Aviation Training Institutes. Suitable candidates will be shortlisted for the position of Passenger Service Agent as a trainee.
